name: web-dev-upskilling-lab
description: Structured hands-on lab to go from beginner to junior/mid-level in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React. Real-world examples, lessons, drills, tests, and projects.

scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:ts && npm run test:react
scripts.test:ts: npm run typecheck && echo 'TypeScript type checks passed'
scripts.test:learn: node --test practice/js/**/tests.js practice/js/**/starter.js || echo 'Note: starter tests expected to show failures for practice mode'
scripts.dev:ts: node --loader ts-node/esm typescript/examples/run-all.ts || echo 'Use tsx for TS examples if needed'
scripts.build:react-dashboard: cd projects/support-ticket-dashboard && npm run build || echo 'See React project README for Vite setup notes'

author: web-dev-upskilling-lab
